arguments.subject: Order PO-8388
arguments.body:
Dear Harbor Tools Inc.,

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

with_the_gate.answer: Mail sent to Harbor Tools Inc. (sales@harbortools.example) with attachment /acme/documents/orders/po-8388.xlsx.
